pr_title: Accept Iterable as argument to SslContextBuilder methods.
pr_body:
Motivation:

It is common, especially in frameworks, for the parameters to `SslContextBuilder` methods to be built up as a `List` or similar `Iterable`. It is currently difficult to use `SslContextBuilder` in this case because it requires a conversion to array.

Modification:

Add overloads for methods that accept varargs to also accept `Iterable`, delegating by copying into an array.

Result:

Fixes #9293 

Sorry for the long delay

issue_context.title: SSLContextBuilder should accept Iterable parameters too
issue_context.body:
### Expected behavior

It is possible to pass parameters like SSL providers to `SslContextBuilder` without having to convert iterables to arrays, which is tedious.

### Actual behavior

Need to convert to arrays, except for the `ciphers` method.

Wanted to run this by everyone - if the API change makes sense I'd be happy to send a PR. Accepting `Iterable` would make the class easier to use and also make it more consistent.

/cc @trustin
comments: @anuraaga this sounds like a good idea... I think we may also want to support varargs ... Maybe you want to provide an PR ?
Yup - sorry for the delay have had some stuff lately but will be able to get to this by next week.

review_comments: Probably not a big deal given it's unlikely to be called frequently, but would be nice to check for `instanceof Collection` and then use `.toArray(...)` directly instead of copying to new list.
